dmp.description: Greenhouse emissions are one of the biggest problems humanity is dealing with [1]. Many industries emit high amounts of these gases to the atmosphere. There are many approaches of how to use this excess products in an advantageous way. In particular, plasma technology has proven to be a capable way to fight the problems exposed and get high valuable products as an outcome. In this work, an experimental study of 𝐴𝑟-𝐶𝑂_2, 𝐴𝑟-𝐶𝐻_4 and Ar-Biogas microwave plasma at atmospheric pressure is carried out.
